混合条件句与错综时间: 当从句和主句的时间不一致:一个看过去,一个看现在,各用各的规则。

从句过去 + 主句现在:If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.|从句现在 + 主句过去(少见):If he were braver, he would have spoken up yesterday.|判断步骤:先定从句时间,再定主句时间|now, today, this week 提示主句指现在|yesterday, last year 提示指过去
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
column3: 我当年要是学了医,现在就是医生了。

混合条件句与错综时间: If she weren't so shy, she would have introduced herself at the party.
column3: 她要不是那么腼腆,昨晚聚会上早就自我介绍了。

混合条件句与错综时间: If the bridge had been built, the village would have a link to the city today.
column3: 桥要是当年修好了,村子今天就有进城的通道。

混合条件句与错综时间: He would be running the department now if he had stayed.
column3: 他要是没走,现在正管着这个部门。

混合条件句与错综时间: If I were more organised, I would have filed the receipts last week.
column3: 我要是更有条理,上周就把收据归档了。

# title: If we ___ the turning, we would be there by now.
column4: 错过岔路是过去的事,主句 by now 指现在:hadn't missed。

# title: If he ___ a lighter pack, he would have summited yesterday.
column4: 主句 yesterday 指过去,与过去相反,从句用 had carried。

# title: She would have the invoice by now if the post ___ on strike.
column4: 罢工发生在过去,主句 by now 指现在。

# title: If I ___ better at maps, I wouldn't have walked the wrong way last night.
column4: 方向感差是现在的长期状态,用 were;last night 只是主句时间。

混合条件句与错综时间: If you had saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.|If you saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.|If you had saved the file, we wouldn't have panicked now.|If you would save the file, we aren't panicking now.
column4: 过去没存文件(had saved)+ 现在正慌(wouldn't be panicking now)。

# title: If the museum ___ free on Mondays, we would have gone last week.
column4: 长期政策属现在/一般情况,用 were;last week 是主句时间。
